explain.summary: A Zeiss CZI microscopy file (format version 1.0), 14.0 MiB, holding 3 images. Each is a 3-channel fluorescence z-stack (5 slices) of 475 × 325 pixels at 1.08 µm per pixel, acquired on 2019-06-27.
paragraphs: Experiment: measured by spinning disk confocal microscopy (FBbi:00000253) (immersion Air, objective Plan-Apochromat 20x/0.8 M27, objective magnification 20, objective na 0.8, pixel size 1.08 µm, z step 1 µm); operator ruiany.

The file holds 3 images (scenes, stage positions or series; choose one with `--image N`). Image 0 (“P2”): 475 × 325 pixels, a field of view of 515 µm × 352 µm at 1.08 µm per pixel; 5 focal planes 1 µm apart (a depth of 4 µm); 3 channels; pixels are 16-bit values (0 to 65535); 15 planes in total. Image 1 (“P3”): 475 × 325 pixels, a field of view of 515 µm × 352 µm at 1.08 µm per pixel; 5 focal planes 1 µm apart (a depth of 4 µm); 3 channels; pixels are 16-bit values (0 to 65535); 15 planes in total. Image 2 (“P1”): 475 × 325 pixels, a field of view of 515 µm × 352 µm at 1.08 µm per pixel; 5 focal planes 1 µm apart (a depth of 4 µm); 3 channels; pixels are 16-bit values (0 to 65535); 15 planes in total.

Channels of image 0: 0 “EGFP” (EGFP, excited at 488 nm, green light at 509 nm, spinningdiskconfocal, 10 ms exposure, shown in #00FF5B); 1 “TaRFP” (TagRFP, excited at 558 nm, yellow light at 583 nm, spinningdiskconfocal, 10 ms exposure, shown in #FF4500); 2 “Bright” (TL Brightfield, spinningdiskconfocal, 10 ms exposure, shown in white (grey scale)).

Imaged through a Plan-Apochromat 20x/0.8 M27 objective (20× magnification, numerical aperture 0.8, air (dry) immersion), on a Carl Zeiss Microscopy Axio Observer.Z1 / 7 instrument, recorded by ZEN 2.3 (blue edition) 2.3.69.1017.
